post.title: Sent Zelle to the wrong person? Here's what happens
post.ig:
Sent Zelle to the wrong person? Your bank may not be able to fix it.
Zelle says a completed payment to an enrolled user can't be canceled.
If the recipient isn't enrolled yet, it stays pending: cancel it, or it expires after 14 days.
Under federal Regulation E, a payment you sent yourself is generally not "unauthorized". Still, report it to your bank right away.
Zelle moved over $1.2 trillion in 2025. Check the name and number before you send.
Sources: Zelle FAQ and 2025 press release, CFPB Regulation E (12 CFR 1005.2).
